scope: Targeted primary-source checks for the strongest retirement cases, not an exhaustive new open-status audit of the catalogue or an independent verification of paper proofs.

checks.title: A Time- and Message-Optimal Distributed Algorithm for Minimum Spanning Trees
checks.checked_scope: Abstract and introductory theorem description; publication metadata corroborated.
checks.finding: A Las Vegas algorithm simultaneously achieves O-tilde(D + sqrt(n)) time and O-tilde(m) messages with high probability. These are the two historical target bounds in the saved card.
checks.limit: This is the randomized target. No new deterministic target is inferred.

checks.title: Undecidability of Network Coding, Conditional Information Inequalities, and Conditional Independence Implication
checks.result_date: May 2022 preprint; IEEE Transactions on Information Theory 69(6), June 2023
checks.checked_scope: Introduction, finite-support convention and Theorem 3 statement.
checks.finding: The conditional-independence implication problem is undecidable for finite-support random variables when alphabet sizes have no fixed bound.
checks.limit: Fixed cardinalities have different decidability behavior. This does not resolve the separate unconditional Shannon-inequality card TCS-6608.

checks.title: Random walks and forbidden minors II: A polynomial-query tester for minor-closed properties of bounded-degree graphs
checks.checked_scope: Abstract and Theorem 1.1 on PDF page 2, explicitly referring to Goldreich's historical problem.
checks.finding: For each fixed minor-closed property there is a two-sided tester with polynomial dependence on degree and inverse proximity, independent of graph size.
checks.limit: Constants depend on the fixed property. The result does not assert a one-sided tester with the same guarantee.

checks.title: Universal Online Learning: an Optimistically Universal Learning Rule
checks.checked_scope: Published abstract and PDF abstract; matched to the saved COLT 2021 source and its weak/strong deterministic-target questions.
checks.finding: The published result characterizes learnable input processes and supplies optimistically universal learning for general input and value spaces in both weak and strong settings, explicitly closing the COLT 2021 questions.
checks.limit: Do not extend the conclusion to arbitrary dependent responses in TCS-2654.

checks.title: Monotone Complexity of Spanning Tree Polynomial Re-Visited
checks.checked_scope: Published abstract and introduction on PDF page 2, compared with the exact extracted sentence in the full canonical card.
checks.finding: The selected sentence is a broad introductory motivation about cancellation. The paper supplies strong exponential monotone lower bounds for spanning-tree polynomials in VP, rather than leaving that concrete separation as its open target.
checks.limit: The broader study of monotone versus unrestricted complexity is not declared solved; the problem is the absence of an independent residual target in this extraction.

checks.title: Existing card's raw-table consistency check
checks.checked_scope: Full current formal statement, definitions, answer criterion and recorded consistency calculation. The original paper was not newly re-audited here.
checks.finding: For an address of probability at least 1/n, outputting that input-table bit has agreement at least 1/2 + 1/(2n). This directly conflicts with the card's literal unrestricted inverse-polynomial-advantage lower-bound target.
checks.limit: The observation concerns the displayed raw-table model, not the source's separate worst-case theorem or a corrected intended average-case problem.
